description_en: Lists the host accounts that are configured for a host in a Bastionhost instance. Host accounts are the credentials used by O&M engineers to log on to the host
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-host-accounts --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListHostAccounts

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机所在堡垒机的实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机所在堡垒机的地域ID。

地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host for which you want to query host accounts.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html operation to obtain the host ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询主机账户的主机ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.
The maximum value of the PageSize parameter is 100. The default value is 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page. We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。 建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the host account that you want to query. The name can be up to 128 characters in length. This parameter supports only term queries
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的主机账户名称。最多支持128字符，仅支持精确查询
parameters.name: host_account_name

parameters.help_en:
The protocol of the host account that you want to query.
Valid values: SSH RDP
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机账户的协议名称。
取值： SSH RDP
parameters.name: protocol_name

parameters.help_en:
The array of host IDs for which you want to query host accounts.

This parameter takes effect only when the value of the HostId parameter is 0. If the HostId parameter is specified with a non-zero value, this parameter is ignored
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询主机账户的主机ID数组。
当HostId参数有值且不为0时，将忽略本参数。仅当HostId参数取值为0时，本参数有效
parameters.name: host_ids

HostAccounts.description_en: The list of the returned host accounts
HostAccounts.description_zh: 查询到的主机账户列表

HasPassword.description_en:
Indicates whether a password is set for the host account.
Valid values: true: A password is set. false: No password is set
HasPassword.description_zh:
当前主机账户是否设置了密码。
取值： true：已设置密码。 false：未设置密码

HostAccountId.description_en: The ID of the host account

HostAccountName.description_en: The name of the host account

HostShareKeyId.description_en: The ID of the shared key of the host

HostShareKeyName.description_en: The name of the shared key of the host

PrivateKeyFingerprint.description_en: The fingerprint of the private key of the host account
PrivateKeyFingerprint.description_zh: 主机账户的私钥指纹信息

PrivilegeType.description_en:
The permission type of the account.

Privileged: privileged account

Normal: regular account

This parameter is available only for Bastionhost instances of V3.2.47 or later
PrivilegeType.description_zh:
账户权限类型。
Privileged：特权账户
Normal：普通账户
仅支持V3.2.47及以上的版本使用

ProtocolName.description_en:
The protocol of the host account.
Valid values: SSH RDP
ProtocolName.description_zh:
主机账户的协议名称。
取值： SSH RDP

RotationMode.description_en:
The password change mode of the account.

Privileged: The password is changed using a privileged account.

Self: The password is changed without using a privileged account.

This parameter is available only for Bastionhost instances of V3.2.47 or later
RotationMode.description_zh:
账户改密模式。
Privileged：使用特权账户改密
Self：不使用特权账户改密
仅支持V3.2.47及以上的版本使用

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of returned host accounts
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的主机账户总数量
